values.description: ASSY, GRIPPER, THUMB WHEEL, PRINTED PINS, STRANDBEEST V4A

params.name: pin_d
params.comment: rotating M3 pin hole, ISO 273 medium

params.name: shoulder_d
params.comment: J1 runs on an ISO 7379 shoulder screw, shoulder 4 mm

params.name: tap_d
params.comment: M3 thread-forming hole (shoulder screw into the crank gear)

params.name: thin_nut_d
params.comment: recess for an M3 thin nut (DIN 439) on crank 2

params.name: pad_d
params.comment: fingertip pad diameter; clamp gap = 12.53 mm - pad_d

params.name: pin_clear
params.comment: radial play per side of a printed pin in its hole (0.10-0.15)

params.name: ppin_d
params.comment: printed pin shank in the D3.4 holes

params.name: ppin_head_d
params.comment: printed pin head = M3 socket head (fits the D6.5 counterbores)

params.name: ppin_flat
params.comment: D-flat depth on pin + head: print the pin lying on it

params.name: cap_d
params.comment: press-on cap, inside the M3 nyloc envelope (6.4) the layers allow for

params.name: cap_bore
params.comment: cap hole: 0.2 mm interference on the pin (press fit, NEEDS PRINT TEST)

params.name: j1_shoulder
params.comment: J1 shoulder in the D4.2 bores (replaces ISO 7379 D4)

params.name: j1_tip_d
params.comment: J1 press tip into the D2.5 tap hole in the crank gear (NEEDS PRINT TEST)
